query:
SELECT slack_user
        FROM (
            SELECT slack_user,
                   SUM(CASE WHEN reaction_added THEN 1 ELSE -1 END) AS net_hcs
            FROM reactions_log
            WHERE entity_type = 'pre_blast'
              AND entity_id = $1
              AND reaction = 'hc'
            GROUP BY slack_user
        ) AS hc_counts
        WHERE net_hcs > 0
        ORDER BY slack_user
